data.one_liner: Converts OPUS audio files between OGG and CAF container formats using pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: It converts OPUS audio files between standard OGG containers and Apple CAF container formats in either direction. It also supports repackaging and repairing OGG Opus container files without re-encoding the audio.
use_when: You need to make OGG Opus recordings playable on iOS devices by converting them to CAF.
You need to convert Apple CAF audio files into standard OGG format for cross-platform support.
You need to sanitize and repair OGG Opus container framing and granule positions.
avoid_when: Your app requires web platform support, as the package relies on `dart:io` and 64-bit integer bitmasks incompatible with Dart2JS.
You need to transcode or encode audio from scratch using native codecs.
strengths: Zero external dependencies and pure Dart implementation.
Fast conversion speeds because audio is not re-encoded, only repackaged.
Supports both file-system operations and in-memory byte arrays (`Uint8List`).
weaknesses: Not supported on the web platform.
Limited specifically to OGG and CAF container formats for the OPUS codec.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or dependencies required. Just add the package to pubspec.yaml.
